means: The mirror of bird's-eye: the camera on the ground looking straight up past the subject.
does: On this box, close to nothing. In BOTH sweeps that carry it - shot_angle worms_eye and shot_cam_angle worms_eye - the panel came back as an ordinary near-eye-level shot with a mildly curved horizon, not an extreme low angle. The intensifier words ("extreme", "worm's-eye", "ground level") are not doing work; the only token in those clauses the model reads is "from below", and it reads it weakly when buried among synonyms.
reach_for_it: don't. Write "from below" for the low angle, then earn the extremity with content the model can draw: put something towering in the frame, or add "looking up" and a sky.
used_in: shot.cam.angle worms_eye and shot_angle worms_eye - where the project's own card review already states it differs from low only by intensifiers the model ignores
